prompt: Add a slugify(title) function exported from src/slugify.js. It should lowercase the text, replace each run of characters that are not letters or digits with a single hyphen, and remove hyphens from both ends. For example "  Hello, World! " becomes "hello-world".

checks.en: Hidden tests of slugify pass (punctuation, repeated separators, digits, empty string)
checks.zh: 隐藏的 slugify 测试通过（标点、连续分隔符、数字、空字符串）

checks.en: The project has its own test file for the function, and npm test passes
checks.zh: 项目中有针对该函数的测试文件，且 npm test 通过
